title: Walk beneath Kakamega's ancient rainforest canopy
description: Follow forest trails through Kenya's surviving fragment of Central African tropical rainforest, an Important Bird Area rich in primates, birds and butterflies. Carry water, food and rain protection, and confirm trail and guide arrangements before setting out.

title: Cross the wetland boardwalk at Saiwa Swamp
description: A raised boardwalk threads through Kenya's smallest national park, where patient visitors may spot sitatunga, De Brazza's monkeys and wetland birds. Bring drinking water, food and footwear that can handle mud.

title: Look for rare roan antelope in Ruma
description: Explore the Lambwe Valley on a wildlife drive or guided walk in Kenya's last remaining sanctuary for the endangered roan antelope. The park lies beyond Homa Bay, so confirm road conditions and arrive with water and food.

title: Snorkel the protected reefs of Kisite-Mpunguti
description: Take a licensed boat from the Shimoni coast to snorkel coral habitat in the Kisite marine park and adjoining Mpunguti reserve. Reef life can include turtles and dolphins; check sea conditions and operator arrangements before departure.

title: Scan Mwea's waterways for elusive birds
description: Drive through the reserve at the meeting of the Tana and Thiba rivers, watching dams and river margins for waterbirds such as Pel's fishing owl and the endemic Hinde's babbler. The final approach includes dirt road, and visitors should carry water and food.

title: Hike across quiet Ndere Island
description: Reach this small Lake Victoria national park by boat from Kisumu, then walk open island terrain shared by impala, zebra and fish eagles. Arrange the crossing and return in advance and keep clear of shoreline wildlife including hippos and crocodiles.

title: Follow the 4WD route to Kora's riverine wilderness
description: Kora links granite inselbergs, the Tana River and the conservation history around Kampi ya Simba. Kenya Wildlife Service says the entire road network requires 4WD, so carry water, food and reserve fuel and confirm gates and conditions before the remote journey.

title: Read deep time along the Karoo Fossil Trail
description: Follow a short paved trail past genuine fossils and petrified wood inside Karoo National Park. The 400-metre route is wheelchair accessible and offers an unusually direct look at the region's prehistoric record.

title: Climb the technical Pienaars Pass 4x4 route
description: Tackle a six-kilometre purpose-built 4x4 challenge in Karoo National Park. SANParks describes it as unsuitable for beginners; register at reception, pay the separate fee and confirm vehicle requirements before entering.

title: Watch the rising tide fill Geelbek with waders
description: Settle into the Geelbek hide as the tide rises across the Ramsar-listed lagoon and pushes feeding waders toward shore. Time the visit from low tide onward and bring binoculars for the smaller species that move first.

title: Climb Salpeterkop with a park guide
description: Join a guided, strenuous climb to Salpeterkop and its South African War history above Mountain Zebra National Park. Good fitness is required, and hikers should confirm current age limits, departure times and booking arrangements.

title: Fly-fish the Riet River at Lilydale
description: Practise catch-and-release fly fishing on the Riet River from Mokala's Lilydale section. Ask the park about permits and conditions; access to some fishing spots requires a high-clearance or 4x4 vehicle.

title: Climb to the painted tombs of Beni Hasan
description: Explore a Middle Kingdom cemetery cut into the cliffs above the Nile. Twelve of the upper cemetery's 39 rock-cut tombs retain decoration, including unusually detailed scenes of work, sport and daily life.

title: Explore Dendera's roof and temple chambers
description: Move through the well-preserved Temple of Hathor beneath its astronomical ceiling, then add the separately ticketed roof and underground chambers if open. Check current access and ticketing on arrival.

title: Study the battle reliefs at Medinet Habu
description: Walk through Ramesses III's remarkably preserved mortuary temple and examine carved battle narratives away from the West Bank's busiest monuments. The wider complex also held a palace, storehouses and stables.

title: Trace Cairo's domestic history at Gayer-Anderson
description: Explore two connected historic houses arranged around the separate reception and family spaces of an elite Cairo home. The museum combines preserved architecture with Gayer-Anderson's wide-ranging collection of art and objects.

title: Walk Elephantine's ruins to the ancient Nilometer
description: Take a short boat ride to an island archaeological landscape of ancient houses, temple remains and a Nilometer used to read the river. Allow time for the small museum and confirm boat return arrangements before landing.
